findings.detail: Cross-account isolation for notifications, ticket ledger, recommendations, follows, profiles, applications and other user-owned resources is not established by source inspection alone.
findings.action: Add two-account Worker/D1 tests proving every read, update, delete, export and background job is scoped to the authenticated owner.

findings.detail: The current /api/admin/users/:id PATCH handler defaults omitted verified and banned fields to false, does not reject unknown or empty fields, has no last-active-admin guard, and does not write an atomic audit record.
findings.action: Replace destructive defaults with explicit-field allowlisting, protect the last active admin, and batch the account update with a conditional audit entry. Add concurrent D1 tests.

findings.detail: POST /api/taxonomy accepts creator_id and creator_name directly from the request body. No IP rate limit is applied in the handler, so submitter attribution can be spoofed and submissions can be spammed.
findings.action: Derive submitter identity only from the verified session, ignore client-supplied creator fields, add bounded IP/account rate limiting, and test spoof attempts and abuse limits.

findings.detail: Public comment reads and authenticated comment writes filter by comment status and novel id but do not require the parent novel to be published and rights-eligible.
findings.action: Join the parent novel on both comment GET and POST and enforce publication_status='published' plus the eligible rights-status set. Add D1 tests for draft, missing and rights-ineligible parents.

findings.detail: The Worker API dispatcher performs schema bootstrap and session lookup without a global Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site check for state-changing requests. SameSite=Lax cookies alone do not provide the complete CSRF control requested by the security plan.
findings.action: Add a carefully scoped same-origin check for unsafe methods before schema/session work, preserve legitimate webhook handling with a separate verified signature path, and add browser-level CSRF tests.

findings.detail: The public vote-board endpoint requires review of returned fields and requester identifiers; the current source has not been proven to minimize its response to the public metadata and aggregate counts required by the UI.
findings.action: Inspect the full GET response projection and remove requester usernames or other personal identifiers unless explicitly necessary and disclosed. Add response-shape regression tests.

findings.detail: AI Story Bible and chapter-generation handlers allow users with the admin role to bypass project-owner checks. This permits privileged generation against another creator's project and can misattribute generation runs.
findings.action: Require strict project ownership for generation and owner attribution even for admins; keep administrative read/oversight routes separately gated. Add two-account runtime tests.

findings.detail: The current admin report PATCH handler updates report status without checking affected rows and returns success for missing ids; it does not create an audit event.
findings.action: Check the affected-row count, return 404/409 for missing or unchanged records as appropriate, and persist an audit event with report id and resulting status.

findings.detail: The current rating API accepts whole-number ratings from 1 to 5 while product requirements specify 1 to 10. The dispatcher also contains a duplicate legacy POST /api/rating handler with inconsistent eligibility checks.
findings.action: Inventory schema constraints, UI controls, stored ratings and consumers; choose a canonical 1-10 migration/normalization plan; remove the duplicate handler only with regression tests. Do not widen the API bound without migration.

findings.detail: Donation approval uses a pending-only transition, conditional balance credit and ledger insertion in a D1 batch. Local SQLite integration tests cover successful approval, replay prevention and ledger-failure rollback; live D1 concurrency is not proven.
findings.action: Run isolated Cloudflare D1 concurrency tests for duplicate approvals and verify rollback and ledger invariants before production use.

findings.detail: Several exact API routes have no explicit method guard in the dispatcher inventory, including /api/taxonomy, /api/me, /api/config, /api/genres and /api/tags. Some intentionally read-only endpoints may still need a consistent 405 response for unsafe methods.
findings.action: Classify each unguarded route as intentional read-only or method-agnostic; add explicit allowed-method handling and 405 responses with Allow headers where appropriate.

findings.detail: Owner scoping is present on several author collections and job-history reads, but cross-account enforcement for all AI project, chapter job and related resource operations is not proven by static source review.
findings.action: Add two-account tests for project detail, Story Bible, chapter generation, job status/history, cancellation, export and all project mutations.
